# Ginés Sánchez

> Ginés Sánchez is an anthropologist turned builder. He builds software and
> companies at Alteridad.

Ginés trained as an anthropologist, writing his dissertation in linguistic
political ecology. He now builds software and companies at Alteridad. His work
uses language models and software to help organisations recover context, make
better decisions, and see what their actions cause.

## Selected work

- Culture Decides: notes toward a book (September 1, 2026).
- [Alteridad](https://www.alteridad.org/): software and company building.
